name: Suspension ropes (6 x 10 mm)
explanation: Suspension ropes AT RISK: health 11/100, 95% failure probability within 30 days, estimated remaining life ~10 days. Key drivers: rope tension imbalance 19.0% (above alarm limit 10.0%); vibration rms 0.144 g (above alarm limit 0.120 g). Recommended: Uneven load sharing - the most-loaded rope wears exponentially faster (Basquin). Re-tension the rope set and inspect the most-loaded rope for broken wires.

contributing_factors.label: Rope tension imbalance
contributing_factors.advice: Uneven load sharing - the most-loaded rope wears exponentially faster (Basquin). Re-tension the rope set and inspect the most-loaded rope for broken wires.

contributing_factors.label: Vibration RMS
contributing_factors.advice: Rope/car sway energy rising - check guide shoes and rope tension equalisation.

contributing_factors.label: Imbalance growth rate
contributing_factors.advice: Tension imbalance is widening day by day - intervene before the next inspection cycle.

contributing_factors.label: Fatigue life consumed
contributing_factors.advice: A large share of rated bending cycles has been used - plan rope replacement.

material_spec.material_type: Steel wire rope 8x19 Seale + fibre core
material_spec.composition: High-carbon steel wire (0.6-0.9 % C), natural/synthetic fibre core
